title: Extension MVP Builds
meta: A focused first version of your extension idea, built fast so you can test it with real users. From $350, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Extension MVP builds to test your idea fast
overview: Not sure the idea will land? We build the smallest version that proves it. Together we cut your idea down to one job the extension does well, then we build it, add basic usage counts that respect privacy and package it for a private or public release. You can share it with early testers quickly and decide what to build next with real feedback in hand.

faq: What if my idea is still rough?
That is normal for an MVP. Send a paragraph, a sketch or links to similar tools. We help you pick the one use that matters most and write the scope down before we build anything.
Can the MVP grow into the full product?
Yes. We write clean Manifest V3 code you own, so you can add features later with us or any developer. The code is not throwaway.
Do I need to put it on the store to test it?
No. We give you a loadable test build for early testers. When you are ready, we package it for the store, and you can publish it as unlisted first if you prefer.
How do usage counts respect privacy?
We count simple events such as a button press, with no names, page content or browsing history. We write the data use down in plain words so your store privacy form is accurate.
